restriction: Listed as a prohibited substance in cosmetic products.

section: SCCS/1614/19, Final Opinion on Zinc Pyrithione (ZPT), submission III, p. 25
hazard: The SCCS assessed the safety of Zinc Pyrithione as an anti-dandruff ingredient in rinse-off hair products, taking into account the overall exposure from other sources.
opinion: The SCCS considers Zinc Pyrithione safe when used as an anti-dandruff ingredient in rinse-off hair products at a maximum concentration of 1%, under the conditions assessed.
conditions: Applies to rinse-off hair products used as anti-dandruff products. Maximum concentration assessed: 1%. The assessment takes overall exposure from other sources into account. The opinion reports no further scientific concerns in response to the second question and no minority opinion.
source_quote: In line with the conditions laid out in Article 15(d) (i.e. ‘overall exposure from other sources’) of the Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009 and taking into account the scientific data provided, the SCCS considers Zinc Pyrithione (ZPT) as safe when used as an anti-dandruff in rinse-off hair products up to a maximum concentration of 1%.
